body.statement: Fix \(m\ge1\) and \(0<\xi\le a_m\), and let \(n\to\infty\). Uniformly over \(h\in H_m(\xi)\), the local honest oracle has the regular order \[\ell_{n,m}(h)\asymp_{m,\xi,\delta_0}n^{-1/2},\qquad \Phi_{n,m}(h)\asymp_{m,\xi,\delta_0}n^{-1/2}.\] The named signed-cell-mean procedure in \(\mathrm{def:signed-cell-mean-interval}\) has jointly calibrated limiting coverage \[\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{h\in H_m(\xi)}P_{m,h}^{n}\{L_m(h)\in(C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_L,\ U_m(h)\in(C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_U\}\ge1-\delta_0.\] An attaining full-profile family can be chosen so that \[\sup_{h\in H_m(\xi)}\frac{R_{n,m}(C_{n,m}^{\star},h)}{\ell_{n,m}(h)}=O_{m,\xi,\delta_0}(1).\] Here first-order equivalence means endpoint-center equivalence only: for every \(\varepsilon>0\), \[\sup_{h\in H_m(\xi)}P_{m,h}^{n}\!\left(\sqrt n\left[\left|\operatorname{mid}((C_{n,m}^{\star})_L)-\operatorname{mid}((C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_L)\right|+\left|\operatorname{mid}((C_{n,m}^{\star})_U)-\operatorname{mid}((C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_U)\right|\right]>\varepsilon\right)\longrightarrow0.\] No expected-length-ratio or Hausdorff equivalence is asserted.
body.justification: This fixed-dimension limit is the precise regular special-case reduction and a falsification check for any claimed all-regime frontier.
body.gap: Fixed-margin influence-function results give a regular endpoint center, but they do not identify the local honest oracle or prove a bounded full-profile oracle ratio on the separated domain.
body.consumer: It recovers conventional efficient endpoint inference in applications whose active max/min operations are well separated.

obligation.what_is_open: The assertions involving Phi_{n,m}, the globally honest family C^star_{n,m}, its bounded local-oracle ratio, and its first-order center equivalence cannot be established before the full-profile OEQ supplies and analyzes that family.
obligation.obstruction: The named signed-cell interval has only asymptotic separated-profile coverage and is not itself a finite-sample member of the globally honest class. Therefore it cannot by itself upper-bound the local honest oracle or witness the claimed ratio. A finite-sample honest switching or test-inversion rule with negligible fallback probability at every separated reference is part of the unresolved full-profile construction.
obligation.attempted: I verified exponential uniform sign recovery, the asymptotic linear expansion of both signed-cell centers, zero cross-covariance across the two strata, variance consistency, and the resulting jointly calibrated Gaussian coverage. These prove the regular limiting-coverage portion but not the load-bearing full-profile-family and oracle-ratio portions.
obligation.partial_result:
For fixed \(m\) and \(0<\xi\le a_m\), the cellwise exponential calculation
used in \texttt{thm:nuisance-learnability} gives constants \(c,C>0\) such
that
\[
 \sup_{h\in H_m(\xi)}P_{m,h}^n
 \left\{\exists(v,j):N_{v,j}=0\ \text{or}\
 \widehat s_{v,j}\ne\operatorname{sign}(h_{v,j})\right\}
 \le Cm\exp\{-cn\min(1,\xi^2)/m\}.                                      \tag{40}
\]
On the complement of this event, ratio expansion of each nonempty cell mean
gives, uniformly over the fixed compact separated set,
\[
 \sqrt n\binom{\overline L_{n,m}-L_m(h)}
                    {\overline U_{n,m}-U_m(h)}
 =\frac1{\sqrt n}\sum_{i=1}^n
 \binom{8k\sum_j\operatorname{sign}(h_{0,j})
 \mathbf1\{V_i=0,J_i=j,S_i=0,T_i=0\}(R_i-h_{0,j})}
 {-8k\sum_j\operatorname{sign}(h_{1,j})
 \mathbf1\{V_i=1,J_i=j,S_i=0,T_i=1\}(R_i-h_{1,j})}
 +o_{P_{m,h}^n}(1).                                                       \tag{41}
\]
The two summands have zero cross-product because the strata are disjoint,
their variances are bounded away from zero, and their third moments are
uniformly bounded for fixed \(m\).  The elementary characteristic-function
expansion of this finite triangular array, together with consistency of the
empirical second moments, therefore proves the jointly independent Gaussian
limit and the stated limiting coverage of
\(C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m}\).  What remains unavailable is the globally
honest full-profile family needed for the claims involving
\(\Phi_{n,m}\), \(C_{n,m}^{\star}\), and the oracle-ratio assertion.
